description: Accessible emoji picker with search, a category toolbar, a listbox of emoji, and undoable insertion into a target field

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of the input, textarea or contenteditable the emoji is inserted into (at the saved caret, as an undoable edit that fires an insertText input event). Omit to handle emoji-picker:select yourself.

attributes.name: recent-limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of recently used emoji kept in localStorage (vb-emoji-recent)

attributes.name: data-trigger
attributes.description: Marks the trigger button (a direct child). Without one the first child <button> is used, else a trigger is created. Hidden until the element is defined (no-JS).

attributes.name: data-label-trigger
attributes.description: Trigger accessible name, applied only when the trigger has no text and no aria-label

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: Accessible name of the picker panel

attributes.name: data-label-search
attributes.description: Accessible name of the search input

attributes.name: data-label-categories
attributes.description: Accessible name of the category toolbar

attributes.name: data-label-emoji
attributes.description: Accessible name of the emoji listbox

attributes.name: data-label-recent
attributes.description: Name of the recently used group

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected state — set by open()/close()/toggle(), not intended as initial markup

events.name: emoji-picker:select
events.description: Fired when an emoji is selected, after it was inserted into the for target

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only. Whether the panel is open

properties.name: ready
properties.description: Read-only. Resolves once the panel is built (emoji data loads asynchronously); data-upgraded is set at the same time

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Open the panel and focus the search input. Queued until the panel is built

methods.name: close()
methods.description: Close the panel (focus is not moved). Before the build it cancels a queued open

methods.name: toggle()
methods.description: Open when closed, close when open. Queued until the panel is built

structure.description: Optional trigger. An emoji-only trigger needs an aria-label.
